name: ckb
description: Turn repositories (a local folder by default, a workspace of git repos, a monorepo, or whole Azure DevOps projects, GitHub orgs and GitLab groups on main/master), plus architecture docs, diagrams, images, notes, cloud IaC and CSPM results, into a cited knowledge graph with function/file/repo call graphs, documentation-vs-code drift, a threat model, scanner-ready context.md files, and a supply-chain audit. Auto mode chooses capabilities from the environment and the code. Read-only on targets.
